Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the juvenile offender basic training camp program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating the juvenile offender basic trainingcamp program; and repealing RCW 13.40.320.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 13.40.320 (Juvenile offender basictraining camp program) and 2002 c 354 s 234, 2001 c 137 s 1, 1997 c 338s 38, 1995 c 40 s 1, & 1994 sp.s. c 7 s 532 are each repealed.
